title: Flipped Classroom Integrated with Digital Technology in Teaching Marxist-Leninist Philosophy to International Medical Students: A Mixed-Methods Experimental Study
reason: All six constructs are self-report Likert scales compared EG vs CG and regressed on each other; AI-RAG query logs are analysed only as aggregate weekly proportions, never related per student to an outcome or construct.

extraction.design: quasi-experimental (EG/CG) with hierarchical regression and mediation, mixed methods
extraction.n_quote: The achieved sample of n = 420 (210 per group) yielded an item ratio of 17.5:1, substantially exceeding minimum requirements and providing 99% power for medium effect detection.
extraction.lms_indicators: AI-RAG query counts and Bloom-level coding of queries (aggregate); LMS formative quizzes not analysed
extraction.outcome_or_construct: self-reported DLA, CLB, SRL, CLA, CTA, TLA
extraction.notes: Regression betas (e.g. CLA beta=0.41 on CTA) relate self-report scales only. Same authors, cohort size (420; 210/210) and six constructs as OUCI2-4NkxOZDV (IJERE 2026): possible duplicate reporting of one study; E2 not applied because the reported figures differ.
